title: Skin Care for Kitchen Heat: Simple Routine for People Who Cook Daily
ex: What stove heat, steam and oil fumes do to your face, what to apply before cooking, a 2-minute after-cooking reset and a night routine.
rt: Skin Care for Kitchen Heat: Daily Cooking Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for kitchen heat: keep layers light before cooking, pat sweat away, wash gently after and use a night cream. Simple routine for Indian home cooks.
quick: Cooking heat, steam and oil fumes leave the face sweaty, oily and dull-looking. Keep only a thin moisturiser on while cooking, tie hair back, pat sweat away instead of rubbing, rinse or gently wash the face afterwards and use a proper cream at night.
facts: Heavy creams turn greasy near the stove
Pat sweat away; rubbing leaves cheeks rough
Heat can make melasma look more noticeable
Cool running water for about 20 minutes on a small burn
